newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Japan gives Senegal $10 million food, water aid.
newsitem.headline: Japan gives Senegal $10 million food, water aid.

text.p: Japan on Monday gave the West African state of Senegal a grant of 1.14 billion yen ($10 million) to improve its water supply and help increase food production, Senegalese officials said.

Of this amount, 585 million yen will be allocated to water supply in rural areas and 550 million yen will be used to increase food production through the purchase of fertilisers and agricultural machinery.
